タイトル: Hostfully Guidebooks the best option for your gests

良い点: How easy it is to customize all the templates to meet your needs, Hostfully gives you the perfect structure and space to tailor the message to your guests in the way you see it fits.

タイトル: Great platform for online and printed vacation rental guidebooks
投稿者: Mark アメリカのMarketing Manager ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great platform for online and printed vacation rental guidebooks"
良い点: Ability to keep information organized as "cards" and then use the cards multiple ways, and update them individually when necessary, it great.Integration with Google Maps and Google search content for pulling in photos and business information about recommendations is really useful.
改善点: We do use the printed version functionality for our condo -- not everyone wants to have to use a phone or tablet to read the house manual content. The printing capabilities have shifted over time and become less user friendly and useful. Would be great to see a bit of development occur around printed versions.More options for look and feel from a design perspective would be nice.

投稿者: Stefani アメリカのDirector of Marketing ホスピタリティ, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great platform. Great support."
良い点: We loved the concept, first and foremost, but what really sold us was how user-friendly it was for the host AND the guest. We wanted the guest experience to be easy for them so our guests felt empowered to answer their own questions and troubleshoot without having to sit on the phone with a guest relations specialist while on their vacation. We put answers in their fingertips and helped set an appropriate expectation pre-arrival.
改善点: There were initially some limitations to the way we wanted to display content to our guests, but since we discussed it with our rep, they have adjusted the software to give us more freedom. I can't think of a negative that is still relevant.

タイトル: Hostfully makes my job so much easier

改善点: I wish we could use the client manager side of Hostfully. Unfortunately in our situation we cannot. This is not a fault of Hostfully but more of the rules when third part booking sites like VRBO interact with them.

投稿者: Dawn アメリカのDirector of Marketing 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Guidebook availability 24/7"

I like being able to populate the Guidebook with recommendations of local things to do that link automatically to Google.
改善点: I wish it were easier to create a guidebook in Spanish for non-native English speakers.

投稿者: Joel アメリカのHost/Manager ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Perfect for our needs"

改善点: Updating guidebook recommendations is sometimes buggy and difficult. Especially when choosing photos, entries sometimes do not save correctly.

投稿者: Ken アメリカのOwner/Operator ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Digital Consierge"

タイトル: Save yourself time while improving your guests' experiences (win-win)
投稿者: Paul ギリシャのChief Experience Officer ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Save yourself time while improving your guests' experiences (win-win)"
良い点: It's no easy feat to manage over 100 vacation homes/rentals. An even bigger challenge is when they're all full of guests! This is where Hostfully guidebooks came in and saved the day. I've been using Hostfully's guidebooks for over 3 years and our guests love them. They find the information and recommendations we provide extremely helpful and because of it, we believe, they enjoy their stay more. Importantly, they are intuitive for first-time users and easy to dive right into. I was never asked by any guests for instructions or for help using them. We provide a QR code in each property which guests can scan to access the guidebook and voila! The management side is very easy and user-friendly. I was able to create almost 100 guidebooks for different unique homes in just 3 days! Hostfully also makes it easy and quick to update the guidebooks using a super-efficient "card" system which I love (it's genius). I used to create and update guidebooks by using a word processor, a very manual and time-consuming approach I would not recommend from the moment Hostfully is around. It's a no-brainer, really... Give it a try!
改善点: None comes to mind, honestly. I provided feedback for improvements when I first started working with Hostfully and the team was always so receptive and appreciated our feedback. They implemented so many improvements since then... so, what I saw as "cons" in the early days have been more or less ironed out.

改善点: Nothing to dislike, even if technophobe this was easy.

投稿者: Kay 英国のOwner ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great Guidebook - disappointing customer care"
良い点: Easy to set upEasy for guests to find the information they need, in one document
改善点: When trying to change my email address on account I was unable to. On contacting customer service they informed me why. I then deleted a Guidebook which was no longer needed, leaving the remaining one which was vital. When I was asked to check the account details, the email had not been changed and the vital Guidebook had been removed (NOT by me). There was no way that I was going to set it all up again. Although I was happy with the Guidebook, this was a bad experience.

投稿者: Tod カナダのProprietor ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Guidebook Brilliance!"
良い点: When I first came across Hostfully Guidebooks I didn't even know I needed it (about four years ago in fall 2017). I used a cumbersome word document to send to my earliest vacation rental clients checking into my condo. It was a very manual process. Now, I own and operate four individual units and integrate my Hostfully Property Management System with Hostfully Guidebooks and we're basically hands-free from running this labour-intensive side of the biz. In short, I'd highly, highly recommend Hostfully from my perspective as a boutique property manager.
改善点: Integration was a breeze. No cons that I can think of.

タイトル: Perfect Guide for My Vacation Rental
投稿者: Marilyn アメリカのManaging Member レジャー、旅行、観光, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Perfect Guide for My Vacation Rental"
良い点: I'm not sure how I found out about the Hostfully Guide, but it couldn't have come around at a better time. I had my own personalized guide, but every time it needed updating it was a major time consuming project. What I like the best is the ease in which I can update and how my guests can access it on their phone, laptop, tablet or computer. Plus they can also pass it along to other family members or friends who will also be staying at our home. Another wonderful feature is that it incorporates both the house manual plus tips on where to dine, shop, visit, etc. I've already promoted the Hostfully Guide several times when new vacation rental managers or owners ask for some tips on how to provide this very information to their guests. And since I only have one home the price is right (FREE!)
改善点: There isn't anything I don't like about it.

タイトル: Excellent Product - I wish I had known about it 4 years ago!
